content: Before writing new code, check whether this was already attempted. git status showed MarketplaceSkillsWatcherService.cs modified (+115/-0) and uncommitted -- read it in full rather than assuming it was unrelated debug noise (as it was mis-flagged in the prior cycle's Checker frame).

Confirm marketplace.json plugin sources already resolve to Z:\pmcro-skills (not a separate static copy)
If an existing uncommitted fix already satisfies the seed intent, verify it (build) rather than reimplementing
Do not commit -- git commit is RequiresHil under this repo's own TerminalCommandPolicy, no base command/subcommand entry exists for it
